# Power Golf Carts - LLM Context

Power Golf Carts is an e-commerce platform specializing in premium electric golf carts and accessories.

## Product Categories
- Electric Golf Carts (E-Carts)
- Follow Me Golf Carts
- Remote Control Golf Carts
- Golf Cart Accessories
- Batteries and Chargers

## Main Brands
- Robera (AI-powered smart carts)
- Ego Caddy (premium electric carts)
- Tasmania (affordable options)
- Volt Caddy (long-range models)

## Key Pages
- Homepage: https://www.powergolfcarts.shop
- Shop: https://www.powergolfcarts.shop/categories
- Brands: https://www.powergolfcarts.shop/brands
- Blog: https://www.powergolfcarts.shop/blog
- Contact: https://www.powergolfcarts.shop/contact

## Policies
- Free shipping within USA
- 30-day return policy
- Warranty support available
- Customer service: support@powergolfcarts.com

## Technology
Built with Next.js 15, TypeScript, MongoDB, and deployed on Vercel.
